words.label: TALKED DOWN
words.text: You talked a monster out of a fight.

friend.label: SOMEONE CAME ALONG
friend.text: A monster you spared chose to come with you.

party.label: A FULL TABLE
party.text: As many friends as the halls let you keep.

chest.label: BEHIND THE CRACK
chest.text: You found what a cracked wall was hiding.

heavy.label: WHERE IT HURTS
heavy.text: A heavy strike showed you how something takes one.

deep.label: THE LAST FLOOR
deep.text: You got all the way down.

door.label: THE LAST DOOR
door.text: It opened, because you weren't alone.

quiet.label: THE QUIET ROUTE
quiet.text: A whole run, and you killed nobody.

blood.label: THE BLOOD ROUTE
blood.text: A whole run, and you spared nobody.

ghost.label: THE GHOST ROUTE
ghost.text: A whole run, and nobody ever saw you.

lonely.label: THROUGH THE DRAIN
lonely.text: You left alone, the way nobody wanted.

roast.label: A FINE ROAST
roast.text: You made a meal of a friend.

nobody_asked.label: NOBODY ASKED
nobody_asked.text: You fed them to the others to the end of the run, and they thanked you.

came_out.label: IT CAME OUT
came_out.text: One of them worked out what was in the stew.
